In RAN1#120bis, RAN1 made the following agreement: RAN1 introduced significant restrictions on the supported codebook configurations, which reduces the required RRC parameters. However, there are still some parameters that need to be configured, primarily the n1/n2 parameters. In our understanding, the only codebooks that need to be considered are described by the RRC IEs CodebookConfig and CodebookConfig-r19. Furthermore, only small parts of these IEs are needed. To make this clean, we propose to introduce a new RRC IE, CodebookConfig-LTM-r19, which contains a choice between Codebook and CodebookConfig-r19. To faciliate the discussions, RRC parameters can be roughly divided into four groups based on the associated functionality and where the parameter configuration for candidate cells is provided: RRC parameters related to CSI measurement report. RRC parameters related to CSI resource set configuration. RRC parameters related to TCI-State configurations RRC parameters related to timing management for LTM. The first three RRC parameters are related to the designs handled in the agenda of L1 measurment and reporting and focus of this paper. The fourth group of TA related RRC parameters are discussed in our companion paper [3].
